lines: Thought Śiva-state-giving before indeed described; as ears I make dance thus by effort so would be.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vikalpaḥ śivatādāyī pūrvameva nirūpitaḥ yathā karṇau nartayāmītyevaṃ yatnāttathā bhavet
